title: The Weevils Who Were Offered Their Own Land #Shorts
description:
A village tried to settle a lawsuit... with a bunch of bugs. In 1545, tiny green beetles called weevils began destroying the vines. The villagers took the weevils to the church court. And the weevils got two lawyers.

▶ Full story: Why Medieval Courts Put Animals on Trial — {LONG_URL}
